title: Loot Novum
description: Remakes quite a few of the vanilla loot tables for a nicer experience
body:
This datapack changes the loot to many existing lootables in minecraft. So far only some structure, archealogy, and mob lootables have been changed. You can see them below!


<details>
<summary>Structure Loot Changes</summary>


<details>
<summary>Buried Treasure</summary>

- Will always have a Coast Armor Trim
- Can have up to 2 heart of the seas, blocks of emeralds, or enchanted golden apples.
- Normally has enchanting bottles, bones, carrots, bread, books, golden carrots, gold ingots, and emeralds.
- Also normally, but more rarely, has iron nuggets, enchanted gold chestplates, enchanted gold swords, golden apples, and sea crystals.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Jungle Pyramid</summary>

- Always has a Wild Armor Trim
- Normally has a bit of bamboo, gunpowder, and/or redstone
- Normally, but fewer, can have emeralds, arrows, raw gold, golden apples, and/or a saddle.
- Has one enchanted piece of equipment being either enchanted chainmail armor(any piece), enchanted stone pickaxes or axes, or a enchanted bow.
- Also always has some rarer building blocks being mossy cobblestone, granite, tnt, or jungle tree sapplings.
- Always has 2 enchanted books with either feather falling, looting, thorns, punch, sharpness, or knockback.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Stronghold</summary>

### Corridor Chests
- Always has either a Eye Armor Trims, 2 Golden Apples, or the Otherside disc
- Normally Have apples, empty bottles, iron ingots, diamonds, and/or enderpearls.
- Can also more rarely have arrows and/or sticks.

### Storeroom Chests
- Always have 1-2 enchanted golden apples
- Always has 2-4 Eye Armor Trims
- Chooses 4-5 times from these items being lapis, empty bottles, apples, carrots, enchanted bottles, emeralds, and more rarely the otherside music disc.

### Library Chests
- Always have some extra items like experience bottles, lapis, paper, and books.
- Always have a enchanted book with 4 pretty good enchantments.
- Can also have a mending book

</details>


<details>
<summary>End City</summary>

- Always has a Spire Armor Trim
- Can sometimes have up to 2 pieces of enchanted diamond equipment(tools, weapons, armor)
- Always has either some diamonds, gold, and/or emeralds
- Can have some popped chorus fruit, chorus fruit, or purpur blocks.
- Can also have either golden carrots, bread, phantom membranes, or enderpearls.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Nether Fortress</summary>

- Always has either a Rib Armor Trim(Very Likely), or a Ghast Harness(Red, Black, or Yellow), or Fungus on a stick, or a Saddle.
- Also always have some good loot like Iron Ingots, Diamonds, Ghast Tears(rarer), or Flint.
- Always have some extra loot like Netherwart, Quartz, and/or Leather.
- Normally has some blocks being either Obsidian, Crying Obsidian, and/or Nether Bricks.
- Can also have a enchanted piece of iron armor, or an enchanted iron sword, or enchanted pickaxe. But they are normally a bit broken having between 30% to 100% health.
- Can have between 0-2 enchanted books each with either fire protection, flame, fire aspect, mending, unbreaking, or protection.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Pillager Outpost</summary>

- Always has a Sentry Armor Trim
- Always has quite a few arrows
- Always has 1 or 2 enchanted crossbow(s) or enchanted stone axe(s). I might change this in a later update.
- Always has quite a few emeralds.
- Always has some building blocks like cobblestone and dark oak logs.
- Always has a goat horn.
- Always has some extra items being Potatoes, Poisnous Potatoes, Wheat, Experience Bottles, and/or coal.
- Has a 50% Chance to have a map to the nearest woodland mansion


</details>


<details>
<summary>Desert Pyramid</summary>

- Always has a Dune Armor Trim
- Normally have emeralds, gold ingots, copper ingots, and/or experience bottles.
- Normally have some "trash" loot like rotten flesh, gunpowder, string, bones, or brown or red mushrooms.
- Can have some building blocks like clay, sandstone, and/or terracotta.
- Can have between 0-2 enchanted books each with either curse of binding, looting, fire aspect, mending, smite, unbreaking, or silk touch.
- Each chest has 1 rarer loot being either, an enchanted golden apple, golden apples, golden horse armor, 2-4 raw iron, an ominous bottle, or another dune trim.

</details>



</details>

<details>
<summary>Mob Loot Changes</summary>


<details>
<summary>Villagers</summary>

- Can Drop Emeralds
- Can also more rarely drop a stick, apple, wheat, or paper.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Husks</summary>

- Normally drop Rotten Flesh
- Can rarely drop a Gold Ingot, Carrot, potato or sans.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Warden</summary>

Not meant to be killed but if he somehow is, then heres a little reward
- Always drops a Catalyst
- Always drops between 8-21 echo shards
- Always drops 3-6 diamonds
- Always drops a Silence Armor Trim

</details>


<details>
<summary>Goats</summary>

- Can drop 1-2 mutton, will be cooked if goat was on fire or killed with a firey enchant.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Wandering Traders</summary>

- Normally drops some emeralds
- Normally drops wheat
- Can drop 0-2 of either bottles, brown mushrooms, and/or red mushrooms.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Piglin Brute</summary>

- Will now drop 1-2 gold ingots, and/or netherite scraps.

</details>



</details>

<details>
<summary>Archaeology Loot Changes</summary>
Will give any of the items in the bullet list since its pretty hard to read in paragraph form. Some of this loot I still think is a bit trashy so I might tweak it some more.

<details>
<summary>Trail Ruins</summary>


### Common Loot
- Emerald
- Bone
- Flower pot
- Raw Gold
- Brick
- Wheat
- Coal
- Lead
- Candles(most colors)
- Raw Copper Block
- Raw Iron block
- String
- Gunpowder.

### Rare Loot
- Pottery Sherd(either burn, danger, friend, heart, heartbreak, howl or sheaf.)
- Relic Music Disc
- Host or Raiser or Wayfinder or Shaper Armor Trim
- Skeleton Skull
- Golden carrot
- Emerald block.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Desert Wells</summary>
 
- Emerald
- Gold Ingot
- Suspicious Stew(haste or luck)
- Pottery Sherd(arms up or brewer)
- Brick
- A Lead
- Glass bottle.

</details>

</details>

For the next lootables I might try changing/tweaking, im thinking about
- Fishing
- Some Piglin Bastion Chests
- Some Trial Chamber loot like certain chests and spawner loot
- Some Village Chests
- Maybe Evoker loot
- Underwater Archoealogy stuff
- Adding more specific enchanting books to specific structures
- Changing some stone tool loot to copper when porting up
- Maybe Redoing some that i touched on already

Some changes were inspired by [this dude](https://www.youtube.com/@Spaadez).
Ok thats it have fun if you like it and bye.
